text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E after gains may reflect a desire to lock in wins; I should base decisions on future prospects, not my purchase price or discomfort with losses.","The account’s ups and downs so far offer no reliable forecast in a random market; I should avoid treating recent price moves as signals.","I should assess the whole portfolio and my risk tolerance before acting, rather than letting loss aversion or frequent account checks drive decisions."]}
